_meta.description: Heart event #4 for npc_kiery: The Truth

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Jack. I need to tell you why I came to Coppervale.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I was with someone. In my old town. He said he loved me.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: But what he loved was controlling me. Every choice. Every word.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I left with nothing. Arrived here with a needle and a spool of thread.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I rebuilt myself. Thread by thread. Stitch by stitch.

options.text: You're the strongest person I know.
You built something beautiful from nothing.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I chose my own fabrics. My own colors. My own hours.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I chose who to smile at. I chose when to be alone.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: And now... I'm choosing who to trust. That's harder.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: But I'm choosing, Jack. On my own terms.
